In this role, you will design, implement, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines and automation processes to enhance deployment speed, reliability, and security. You will work extensively with AWS cloud services, infrastructure as code, containerization, and monitoring solutions. lists.content:

  • Design, implement, manage, and continuously improve CI/CD systems, pipelines, and deployment processes across software teams.

  • Establish DevOps standards and practices to improve software delivery speed, deployment quality, and operational efficiency.

  • Manage AWS cloud infrastructure, including services such as EC2, Auto Scaling Groups (ASG), VPC, ECS, EKS, and S3.

  • Administer GitHub and Atlassian platforms, including Jira and Confluence, managing user access, permissions, and security controls.

  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization across development and production environments.

  • Develop and maintain automation solutions and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and AWS CDK.

  • Implement monitoring and observability practices using tools such as AWS X-Ray, CloudWatch, Grafana, logs, and alarms.

  • Support microservices architectures and manage cloud-based infrastructure and virtual environments.

  • Manage Linux and Windows cloud servers, including virtualization, image creation, and customized operating system builds.

  • Define and implement containerization standards using Kubernetes, evaluating on-premise and cloud solutions from providers such as Red Hat and SUSE.

  • Apply security best practices across infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and software deployment processes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on DevOps experience with solid cloud infrastructure knowledge and the ability to establish scalable engineering practices.   • Strong knowledge of AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian tools, particularly Jira and Confluence.

  • Very good understanding of DevOps principles and methodologies, including The Three Ways and CALMS.

  • Solid experience with AWS cloud services, including EC2, Auto Scaling Groups, VPC, ECS, EKS, and S3.

  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools and practices, including AWS X-Ray, CloudWatch, Grafana, logging, and alerting.

  • Experience developing, monitoring, and optimizing cloud infrastructure and associated costs.

  • Hands-on experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and AWS CDK.

  • Experience with virtualization technologies, image creation, and customized operating system builds for virtualized environments.

  • Proven ability to define and implement CI/CD pipeline standards and security best practices.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer - Advertising Industry based in Brazil.

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to lead the evolution of cloud infrastructure and developer platforms powering next-generation, AI-native digital solutions. In this role, you will drive cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, continuous integration and delivery, and security practices across complex engineering environments. You will work closely with distributed engineering teams to build highly available, scalable, and reliable systems while improving developer productivity and operational efficiency. Combining deep DevOps expertise with emerging AI-enabled technologies, you will help modernize workflows and accelerate software delivery. This position offers the opportunity to influence technical strategy, optimize cloud operations, and contribute to innovative digital projects within a collaborative, international environment.

lists.content:
As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will own and continuously improve cloud infrastructure, automation practices, and operational processes. You will collaborate with engineering teams to ensure secure, efficient, and reliable software delivery while introducing innovative AI-driven approaches to infrastructure management and development workflows.

  • Design, provision, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure, ensuring high availability and operational reliability.

  • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support secure and efficient software delivery from development through production.

  • Lead Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using Terraform and other automation tools to create consistent, reproducible, and auditable environments.

  • Manage containerized applications and infrastructure using Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Implement DevSecOps practices throughout the software development lifecycle, including security scanning, identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, and automated security controls.

  • Own infrastructure and application observability, including monitoring, logging, alerting, tracing, and incident troubleshooting.

  • Design and maintain fault-tolerant architectures and implement deployment strategies such as blue-green deployments, canary releases, and feature flags.

  • Support serverless architectures, cloud-native services, cloud networking, CDNs, load balancers, and edge platforms.

  • Drive cloud cost optimization and FinOps initiatives by identifying inefficiencies, right-sizing resources, and improving infrastructure utilization.

  • Improve developer experience by streamlining workflows, enhancing internal tooling, and removing friction throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

  • Develop automation scripts and operational tools using Python, Bash, and Linux-based technologies.

  • Maintain technical documentation, architecture guidelines, operational runbooks, and post-incident reviews to support continuous improvement.

  • Leverage AI-enabled development tools and agentic workflows to accelerate infrastructure automation, debugging, and operational processes.

  • Orchestrate multi-step AI-driven workflows by selecting appropriate models, tools, and execution strategies for different engineering use cases.

  • Review and strengthen AI-assisted outputs to ensure security, scalability, maintainability, reliability, and architectural alignment.

  • Contribute to prompt development, evaluation frameworks, technical documentation, and operational context systems that improve engineering productivity.

  • Support automated evaluation and feedback mechanisms for AI-enabled engineering workflows.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on DevOps and cloud infrastructure experience, combined with strong automation, security, and problem-solving capabilities. You should be comfortable working across modern cloud environments, collaborating with distributed technical teams, and applying emerging AI technologies to improve engineering operations.

  • Extensive experience provisioning, managing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure using AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, or equivalent tools.

  • Hands-on experience managing Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.

  • Strong understanding of highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud architectures.

  • Knowledge of cloud networking, deployment strategies, and web application infrastructure.

  • Practical experience implementing DevSecOps practices, including cloud security, IAM, secrets management, and automated security scanning.

  • Experience with observability tools and practices covering monitoring, logging, alerting, and troubleshooting.

  • Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, with solid Linux administration skills.

  • Experience optimizing cloud costs and improving infrastructure efficiency.

  • Strong understanding of Git and managed development platforms such as GitHub, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps.

  • Practical experience using AI-enabled development tools and workflows for engineering, automation, debugging, and operational tasks.

  • Experience orchestrating multi-step AI or agent-driven workflows, including model selection, tool integration, and execution strategies.

  • Ability to critically review and improve AI-assisted outputs, ensuring security, scalability, maintainability, reliability, and architectural compatibility.

  • Experience developing or maintaining prompts, evaluation frameworks, technical documentation, or operational context systems.

  • Familiarity with automated evaluation and feedback loops for AI-enabled workflows.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts, collaborate across teams, and produce clear technical documentation.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience working across multiple cloud providers, particularly AWS, GCP, and Azure.

  • Additional Infrastructure as Code experience with AWS CloudFormation or Ansible.

  • Familiarity with serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Functions, or Azure Functions.

  • Experience with edge platforms and CDNs such as Fastly or AWS CloudFront.

  • Knowledge of developer platforms such as Vercel, Netlify, or WP Engine.

  • Familiarity with DevSecOps and observability tools such as Snyk, SonarQube, HashiCorp Vault, Datadog, New Relic, or AWS CloudWatch.

  • Experience configuring NGINX, Traefik, and load balancers.

  • Advanced knowledge of cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.

  • Previous experience in agency, consultancy, or enterprise SaaS environments.

  • Background in AI/LLMOps, including agent orchestration, model selection, prompt engineering, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Relevant AWS, GCP, or Azure certifications.

    • Benefits:

  • 100% Remote Work: Work from the location where you feel most productive, with just a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Competitive USD Compensation: Earn an attractive, market-leading salary paid in US dollars.

  • Paid Time Off: Benefit from paid leave policies that support your well-being and work-life balance.

  • Autonomy and Flexibility: Manage your schedule independently, with an emphasis on results rather than hours worked.

  • International Projects: Collaborate on innovative, high-impact projects with leading American companies.

  • Supportive Culture: Enjoy a workplace that values employee well-being, professional development, and work-life balance.

  • Global Professional Network: Connect with more than 600 professionals across 25+ countries in a diverse, multicultural environment.

  • Experienced Colleagues: Work alongside highly skilled senior professionals and exchange knowledge with experts across different technical fields.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director of EHS&S Learning and Development based in Brazil.

As the Senior Director of EHS&S Learning and Development, you will lead the development and execution of enterprise-wide Environmental, Health, Safety, and Sustainability (EHS&S) learning and capability strategies across multiple business units and global operations. You will establish competency standards, mandatory training frameworks, and governance models that strengthen organizational capabilities and ensure regulatory compliance. Working closely with senior executives, operational leaders, and cross-functional teams, you will translate business risks, audit findings, and emerging industry trends into targeted learning initiatives. You will also oversee the effectiveness of enterprise training programs, ensuring measurable improvements in workforce competency, safety performance, and risk management. This strategic leadership role combines organizational development, learning technology, and EHS&S expertise to drive continuous improvement. You will have significant influence over enterprise priorities, investments, and the development of a consistent global learning culture.

lists.content:
• Define and implement the enterprise-wide EHS&S learning and capability strategy across business units and operations, establishing multi-year priorities, investment requirements, and operating plans aligned with business objectives and emerging risks.
  • Establish and govern enterprise EHS&S competency standards, mandatory training requirements, curricula, and scalable learning frameworks to ensure consistency across global operations.
  • Collaborate with business units, functional leaders, and site teams to support the implementation of enterprise learning standards while accommodating local regulatory requirements and operational needs.
  • Partner with Global EHS Audit and Assurance teams to analyze audit findings, assurance trends, emerging risks, and recurring compliance issues, translating identified capability gaps into prioritized learning initiatives.
  • Develop enterprise competency frameworks that define the knowledge, skills, and capabilities required across EHS&S disciplines and professional levels, supporting both technical and leadership development.
  • Establish enterprise training standards, performance indicators, and governance mechanisms to ensure consistent implementation of required learning programs across sites.
  • Oversee the enterprise EHS&S learning portfolio, ensuring that curricula, programs, and learning solutions remain relevant, effective, scalable, and aligned with evolving business risks and regulatory expectations.
  • Serve as the enterprise authority and strategic advisor on EHS&S learning and organizational capability, influencing senior executives, operational leaders, and site management on priorities, investments, and improvement initiatives.
  • Drive the implementation and effectiveness of enterprise learning interventions, establishing metrics to evaluate competency improvements, compliance readiness, recurring risk trends, audit findings, and incident indicators.
  • Monitor learning outcomes and organizational performance, using data and insights to continuously refine enterprise priorities, training strategies, and capability development initiatives.
  • Lead the enterprise EHS&S learning technology roadmap, overseeing the evaluation, selection, adoption, and effectiveness of innovative learning platforms and solutions.
  • Partner with IT, Human Resources, Communications, and other cross-functional stakeholders to integrate EHS&S learning into enterprise systems and improve the employee learning experience.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning, operational excellence, and accountability, helping reduce workplace injuries, incidents, and regulatory compliance risks.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related discipline.
  • Postgraduate degree in Talent Development, Instructional Design, Human Resources Development, or a related field is preferred.
  • Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD) certification is required.
  • At least 12 years of professional experience in learning and talent development, with a strong background in designing and implementing enterprise-wide learning strategies.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience within the manufacturing, chemical, or pharmaceutical industries.
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing Learning Management System (LMS) technology, strategy, and enterprise learning platforms.
  • Proven ability to develop competency frameworks, mandatory training programs, and scalable learning solutions across complex, multinational organizations.
  • Strong understanding of EHS&S learning requirements, regulatory compliance, risk management, and organizational capability development.
  • Experience translating technical information, audit findings, business risks, and performance data into practical learning strategies and measurable development initiatives.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear and compelling messages for executives, employees, regulators, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic thinking, critical analysis, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to evaluate complex situations and make timely, risk-informed decisions.
  • Demonstrated agility in managing evolving business requirements, competing priorities, and organizational change while maintaining alignment with enterprise objectives.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and establish effective relationships across internal and external teams.
  • Proven leadership capabilities, including the ability to mobilize teams, influence senior stakeholders, and successfully deliver complex enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • High levels of ownership, integrity, accountability, and commitment to organizational success.
  • Strong collaboration and change management skills, with the ability to align diverse teams around shared strategic priorities.

    • Benefits:

  • Access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee health, well-being, and professional development.
  • Opportunity to work in a global organization with operations and teams across multiple international markets.
  • Exposure to strategic enterprise-wide initiatives with significant organizational impact.
  • Opportunities to influence global learning strategies, EHS&S standards, and technology investments.
  • A collaborative and inclusive working environment that values diversity, innovation, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Opportunities to work with senior executives and experienced professionals across multiple business units and functions.
  • Commitment to employee well-being, inclusion, and belonging.
  • Reasonable workplace accommodations and accessibility support throughout the recruitment process, where required.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director, Learning and Impact based in Brazil.

The Senior Director, Learning and Impact will lead the development and implementation of an organization-wide learning and impact strategy, helping turn insights from community partnerships into stronger programs and meaningful outcomes for children and young people. This senior leadership role will shape learning frameworks, strengthen evaluation practices, and build the systems and culture needed to support continuous improvement. Working across international teams and diverse partner networks, you will promote participatory, equitable, and trust-based approaches to measuring change. You will guide the organization through the early implementation of a new programmatic framework, ensuring that evidence informs decisions without placing unnecessary demands on partners. The role also offers the opportunity to influence wider philanthropic conversations around impact, accountability, and community-led learning.

lists.content:
You will provide strategic direction for the Learning and Evaluation function, lead a multidisciplinary team, and ensure that learning is embedded in organizational decision-making and program delivery. You will work closely with Programs, Development, Communications, and Operations to strengthen impact measurement, share insights, and support continuous adaptation. Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead and develop the Learning and Evaluation function, setting its vision, annual priorities, team structure, and budget in alignment with organizational strategy.

  • Manage, coach, and support team members, establishing clear expectations, providing regular feedback, encouraging professional development, and fostering an inclusive team culture.

  • Design, implement, and maintain the organization's learning infrastructure, including systems, tools, processes, and routines that make learning an ongoing organizational practice.

  • Oversee and continuously refine the Learning Agenda and Outcomes Framework, translating strategic priorities into practical indicators, learning questions, and reflection processes.

  • Develop and guide theories of change at organizational, strategic, and impact-area levels, working with program teams and partners to identify assumptions, pathways, and supporting evidence.

  • Steward learning and outcomes frameworks across key impact areas, including gender justice and climate justice, ensuring alignment with broader programmatic goals and approaches.

  • Lead the first three years of the new programmatic framework as a learning phase, using evidence and partner perspectives to test assumptions and refine priorities.

  • Develop credible approaches to demonstrating the organization's contribution to change across children and young people, partner organizations, and wider ecosystems without overstating attribution.

  • Guide or commission research on issues affecting children and young people, collaborating with partners and relevant stakeholders.

  • Analyze qualitative and quantitative information, including partner data, research findings, and learning reviews, to identify patterns and actionable insights.

  • Introduce participatory learning practices, including reflection exercises, evaluation activities, learning conversations, and strategy reviews.

  • Coach program teams to integrate data collection and learning into their daily work while minimizing reporting burdens on partners.

  • Build an organization-wide learning culture that encourages curiosity, honest reflection, openness to challenges, and evidence-informed decision-making.

  • Create regular opportunities for cross-functional reflection and sense-making, bringing together Programs, Development, Communications, Operations, and leadership.

  • Lead the collection and management of quantitative data and qualitative stories across the portfolio, ensuring data quality, governance, and ethical use.

  • Oversee data and knowledge management systems, including the responsible use of AI tools and collaboration on platforms such as Salesforce.

  • Work with safeguarding and communications colleagues to ensure that data collection and storytelling protect the dignity, consent, and safety of children, young people, and communities.

  • Synthesize learning across programs and regions into strategic insights for senior leadership and the Board.

  • Collaborate on impact reports, donor communications, and external publications, sharing organizational learning with partners, peer networks, and the wider philanthropic sector.

  • Model organizational values and commitments to diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility in leadership, collaboration, and decision-making.

    • Requirements:

    You are a strategic and collaborative leader with substantial experience in learning, evaluation, research, or impact management, ideally within an international nonprofit, philanthropic, or social justice environment. You combine strong analytical capabilities with participatory and equity-centered approaches, and can translate complex evidence into practical improvements and compelling narratives for diverse audiences. The following qualifications and experience are expected:

  • At least 9 years of progressive experience leading learning, evaluation, research, or impact functions.

  • At least 5 years of people management experience, including setting direction, supporting staff development, and building effective teams.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing learning agendas and/or outcomes frameworks and ensuring their adoption by program teams.

  • Strong understanding of participatory, equitable, and trust-based approaches to evaluation and learning, with a willingness to challenge conventional practices that may reinforce unequal power dynamics.

  • Familiarity with feminist, decolonial, or other community-led approaches to research, evaluation, and impact measurement.

  • Expertise in mixed-methods research, combining qualitative storytelling with quantitative analysis and synthesis across diverse programs or portfolios.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop theories of change and practical learning and outcomes frameworks.

  • Experience training and coaching program staff to integrate learning and data practices into their work.

  • Proven ability to build a learning culture and facilitate reflection, collaboration, and evidence-informed decision-making across an organization.

  • Exceptional facilitation, communication, and writing skills, including the ability to present complex findings to senior leadership, Board members, and donors.

  • Strong commitment to equity, children's and young people's rights and wellbeing, and ethical data collection and storytelling.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, build trusting relationships, and support equitable participation and shared accountability.

  • Experience working with grassroots, community-based, or youth-led organizations and individual changemakers across different regions is preferred.

  • Familiarity with child and youth development, rights-based approaches, ecosystem perspectives, or life-course frameworks is an advantage.

  • Experience in change management, strategy development, or organizational transitions is beneficial.

  • An advanced degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience is preferred.

  • Experience building or restructuring a learning, evaluation, or impact team is an asset.

  • Familiarity with data and knowledge management systems, AI tools, grants management platforms, or CRM systems is desirable.

  • Knowledge of Salesforce and its use for grants, data, or learning management is an advantage.

  • Fluency in an additional language, particularly Spanish or French, is preferred.

  • Knowledge of gender justice and/or climate justice, including relevant issues, stakeholders, and approaches to measuring change, is beneficial.

  • Experience gained through lived experience, community work, or non-traditional professional paths is welcomed.

    • Benefits:

  • Annual salary range of $105,000–$140,000 for US-based candidates, depending on experience. Compensation for international hires is locally benchmarked according to location, benefits, and experience.

  • Full-time, exempt position.

  • International candidates outside the US and UK may be engaged through an Employer of Record, with benefits aligned with local employment laws.

  • Comprehensive private healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous paid time off, including annual leave, enhanced sick leave, wellbeing days, sabbatical leave, and family-friendly leave.

  • Flexible working arrangements, including remote, hybrid, and compressed work schedules.

  • Pension contributions.

  • Employee Assistance Services.

  • Professional development opportunities, including training, collaboration, mentorship, and access to professional development funds.

  • Team-building activities and social committees.

  • Additional benefits may be available depending on the employee's location.

  • An international, collaborative, and inclusive working environment focused on meaningful social impact.

lists.content:

  • Experience using financial dashboards, reporting platforms, and data visualization tools.
  • Strong analytical abilities and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify meaningful discrepancies and financial trends.
  • Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders without a finance background.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the confidence to raise concerns and recommend improvements.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with accounting, operations, and leadership teams.

lists.content:

  • Develop asynchronous and real-time processing capabilities, ensuring appropriate handling of retries, idempotency, event ordering, and data consistency.
  • Modernize legacy functionality by transitioning it into independent services while maintaining data integrity, system stability, and service availability.
  • Implement secure authentication, authorization, and access management practices to protect customer information.
  • Establish automated testing standards, monitoring, logging, tracing, and safe deployment strategies while participating in incident response and the on-call rotation.

  • Solid understanding of relational databases, including data modeling, indexing, query optimization, transactions, and safe schema migrations.

  • Experience integrating internal services and third-party APIs, with an understanding of service dependencies, failure handling, and system reliability.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, sound technical judgment, and the ability to make practical architectural tradeoffs involving scalability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Conduct digital forensic investigations while ensuring proper evidence collection, preservation, integrity, chain of custody, and documentation.

  • Perform security analysis across Windows, Linux/UNIX, cloud, network, email, endpoint, and enterprise technology environments.

  • Investigate security alerts, system logs, threat intelligence, incident tickets, and reports using SIEM platforms and other security operations tools.

  • Prepare detailed investigation findings, incident briefings, risk assessments, and post-incident reports for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience working with SIEM platforms, security monitoring solutions, email security tools, ticketing systems, and enterprise security operations processes.

  • Broad technical knowledge of enterprise IT environments, including Windows, Linux/UNIX, directory services, AWS, Azure, mobile device management, virtualization, networks, web servers, databases, and firewalls.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

  • Understanding of security controls, security operations, risk management, and enterprise information security governance.

The Senior Media Buyer will play a key role in scaling paid acquisition while building a more automated and efficient media buying operation. Working within the User Acquisition team, you will manage Meta campaigns against ambitious ROI and spending targets, with responsibility for a significant advertising budget. Beyond campaign execution, you will own the roadmap for buying automation, identifying repetitive tasks and translating them into clear technical specifications for engineering partners. You will help develop systems that automate budget pacing, scaling, campaign optimization, alerts, and reporting. This is an opportunity for an independent, data-driven media buyer who enjoys combining hands-on performance marketing with technology and operational innovation.

lists.content:
As Senior Media Buyer, you will combine day-to-day campaign management with ownership of the team's automation initiatives. You will work closely with engineering, analytics, and other acquisition specialists to improve campaign performance, streamline workflows, and create more opportunities for strategic experimentation.

  • Manage a portfolio of Meta advertising campaigns, delivering against ROI and advertising spend targets.

  • Own the buying automation roadmap, identifying opportunities to automate recurring activities such as budget pacing, campaign scaling, campaign pauses, alerts, and reporting.

  • Map existing media buying workflows and translate them into clear, actionable technical specifications that engineering teams can implement.

  • Test automation features on live advertising accounts, validate their performance, identify issues, and provide feedback for improvements.

  • Keep automation rules and workflows up to date as market conditions, campaign strategies, and offers evolve.

  • Support the adoption of automation tools across the User Acquisition team by explaining their functionality, gathering feedback, and improving usability.

  • Maintain a consistent experimentation pipeline covering campaign structures, bidding strategies, audiences, offers, landing pages, and creative approaches.

  • Design experiments with clear measurement criteria to distinguish meaningful performance improvements from statistical noise.

  • Use Mixpanel, spreadsheets, and AI-powered tools to investigate day-to-day performance questions and uncover actionable insights.

  • Collaborate with the analytics team on deeper research and more complex data investigations.

  • Monitor tracking infrastructure, including Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), event configuration, and attribution.

  • Ensure Meta advertising metrics are consistent with internal reporting and investigate discrepancies when they arise.

  • Identify opportunities to improve acquisition efficiency and contribute new ideas for scaling performance across additional channels.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced performance marketer with a strong track record of managing substantial Meta advertising budgets and building automated media buying workflows. You combine commercial judgment with analytical thinking, understand how acquisition performance translates into business outcomes, and can independently turn operational challenges into practical solutions. You are proactive, curious about technology, and comfortable collaborating with engineers without needing to write production code yourself.

  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience buying media on Meta.

  • Experience managing large advertising budgets, ideally $500K or more per month.

  • Background in subscription-based businesses or direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce.

  • Proven experience transitioning a media buying account from manual processes to automated workflows, with the ability to demonstrate what was built and which tasks or processes it replaced.

  • Strong understanding of Meta Marketing API capabilities, rules engines, automation platforms, scripts, and AI agents.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Meta automated rules, Revealbot, and Madgicx.

  • Ability to translate media buying requirements into detailed technical specifications that engineers can implement independently.

  • Comfortable using Mixpanel or similar product analytics platforms, as well as spreadsheets, to investigate performance and support decision-making.

  • Regular use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for analysis, workflow optimization, and routine tasks.

  • Strong understanding of performance metrics, including ROI, CPA, and LTV, with the ability to explain changes in results and identify their underlying causes.

  • Fluent English communication skills. Russian language proficiency is a strong advantage.

  • Strong ownership mindset, independence, and the ability to manage projects from initial planning through implementation and evaluation.

  • Proactive approach to identifying opportunities, proposing improvements, and generating new ideas without waiting for instructions.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience managing additional paid acquisition channels such as TikTok, Snapchat, AppLovin, or Google.

  • Experience with landing page optimization and funnel A/B testing.

  • Experience launching campaigns in new geographic markets.

  • Ability to read and understand scripts written in Python or JavaScript.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive base compensation.

  • Eligibility for a bonus program.

  • Paid time off.

  • Work-from-home flexibility.

  • Creative, energetic, and collaborative working environment.

  • Opportunity to lead an important automation initiative and influence the future of the User Acquisition function.

  • Inclusive workplace that values diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

As a Senior OneTrust Platform Configuration Engineer, you will play a key role in helping organizations strengthen their privacy operations through advanced platform configuration, data engineering, and automation. You will focus on optimizing OneTrust Data Discovery and Data Catalog capabilities to support privacy rights management and end-to-end Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) workflows. Working at the intersection of technology, data, and privacy compliance, you will ensure accurate data inventories and reliable information discovery across complex enterprise environments. You will collaborate closely with technical, legal, privacy, and business stakeholders to implement effective solutions and improve operational processes. This role offers significant autonomy, ownership, and the opportunity to contribute to impactful international projects. You will also participate in technical interviews, helping identify and connect with talented professionals across a growing technology community.

lists.content:
• Configure, maintain, and continuously improve OneTrust Data Discovery and Data Catalog capabilities to support privacy rights automation and enterprise data governance.
  • Manage end-to-end Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) workflows, covering request intake, identity verification, data discovery, response preparation, redaction of out-of-scope information, and request closure.
  • Lead and support the migration of privacy processes, records, and workflows to OneTrust while preserving relevant historical information and facilitating the retirement of legacy privacy platforms.
  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive data catalogs, data maps, and data inventories across multiple enterprise data sources.
  • Review discovered data terms and determine their relevance by approving or rejecting them, while maintaining business glossaries, tags, metadata, and associated attributes.
  • Leverage ETL processes, SQL, and system integrations to connect OneTrust with enterprise data sources and support privacy-related use cases.
  • Collaborate with privacy, legal, technical, and business stakeholders to communicate implementation decisions, resolve challenges, and ensure effective delivery of privacy solutions.
  • Support the continuous improvement of data discovery, privacy automation, and DSAR fulfillment processes.
  • Participate in technical interview programs by conducting candidate assessments for assigned and other project teams, helping identify qualified professionals and support organizational growth.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical professional experience.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with OneTrust, particularly its Data Discovery and Data Catalog capabilities for privacy rights automation.
  • Proven experience managing complete DSAR fulfillment processes, including data discovery, request handling, and redaction of information outside the scope of requests.
  • Senior-level data engineering experience, with strong expertise in ETL processes, SQL, and integrations across enterprise data sources.
  • Demonstrated experience migrating privacy processes, records, and workflows to the OneTrust platform.
  • Working knowledge of privacy regulations, particularly GDPR and CCPA, and a solid understanding of how data subject rights apply across enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data environments, data mapping, data inventories, and information governance practices.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and privacy-related decisions to legal, privacy, and business teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (C1–C2 preferred), with the ability to communicate effectively with US-based clients, participate in meetings, and explain technical solutions clearly.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with attention to detail and a proactive approach to resolving technical challenges.
  • Ability to work independently, manage responsibilities autonomously, and collaborate effectively within remote, multicultural teams.
  • Confidence and interpersonal skills to participate in technical interviews and assess candidates' technical capabilities.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary paid in USD.
  • Fully remote working arrangement across Latin America.
  • Access to coworking spaces throughout the region for those who prefer occasional in-person collaboration.
  • Paid time off in accordance with the employment regulations of your country, with full salary.
  • Paid national public holidays.
  • Sick leave provisions.
  • Annual refundable allowance to support health and personal well-being expenses.
  • Additional day off to celebrate your birthday.
  • Support from a dedicated People Care team for well-being, time off, and employee support.
  • Autonomous working environment with genuine ownership and minimal micromanagement.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with international clients and multicultural technical teams.
  • Professional development opportunities through participation in technical initiatives and interview programs.

We are looking for an experienced paid social professional to manage and scale advertising campaigns for a portfolio of eCommerce clients. This hands-on role focuses primarily on Meta Ads, with additional campaign execution across TikTok and Pinterest. You will turn growth strategies into effective campaigns, using performance data to guide optimization and maximize advertising efficiency. Working closely with Growth Strategists, you will help drive customer acquisition and profitable revenue growth for established and high-growth eCommerce brands. lists.content:

  • Manage campaign structures, audience segmentation, targeting, retargeting, budgets, bidding strategies, placements, and conversion objectives.

  • Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scale investment, and drive profitable growth.

  • Analyze key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, CPM, conversion rates, and revenue.

  • Conduct ongoing tests across audiences, creative formats, messaging, placements, and campaign structures.

  • Identify underperforming campaigns and implement data-driven optimization strategies.

  • Work closely with Growth Strategists to translate client objectives and broader growth strategies into effective campaign execution.

  • Monitor budget pacing and ensure advertising spend is allocated efficiently.

  • Evaluate creative performance and share insights and recommendations with relevant internal teams.

  • Maintain accurate campaign documentation, performance tracking, and reporting.

  • Stay up to date with advertising platform developments, policies, and paid social best practices.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of hands-on paid social advertising experience, preferably managing campaigns for eCommerce or direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

  • Advanced practical expertise in Meta Ads Manager, the primary platform for this role.

  • Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets.

  • Strong understanding of campaign architecture, audience segmentation, prospecting, retargeting, bidding strategies, and budget allocation.

  • Proven ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions.

  • Solid knowledge of eCommerce performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, and revenue attribution.

  • Experience managing multiple campaigns or client accounts simultaneously.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of campaign execution, and prioritize effectively.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with Growth Strategists.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or C2), both written and spoken.

  • Availability to maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with U.S. business hours.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience managing campaigns through TikTok Ads and Pinterest Ads.

  • Experience working with established or high-growth eCommerce brands.

  • Familiarity with Shopify and eCommerce analytics environments.

  • Understanding of full-funnel marketing strategies and the relationship between paid media, customer acquisition, and profitability.

  • Experience with attribution, conversion tracking, and performance measurement tools.

  • Previous experience in a performance marketing agency environment.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote position based in Brazil.

  • Full-time employment.

  • Opportunity to work with a portfolio of established and high-growth eCommerce brands.

  • Collaboration with specialists across paid media execution, growth strategy, and marketing measurement.

  • Exposure to a performance-focused environment combining paid media, advanced measurement practices, and proprietary reporting tools.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Performance Strategist based in Brazil.

The Senior Performance Strategist will shape how creative work performs in market, combining strategic thinking, performance data, and creative innovation to deliver measurable results for global brands. This is a senior strategy role focused on performance creative rather than hands-on media buying, offering the opportunity to advise enterprise clients and influence creative direction. You will lead performance-focused engagements, translate insights into actionable briefs, and build testing and optimisation strategies across channels and audiences. Working closely with creative strategists, production teams, and product specialists, you will help clients understand what drives results and where to invest next. You will also identify opportunities to expand client relationships and develop new performance creative solutions. The role is ideal for an analytical, collaborative leader who embraces emerging technology and wants to help redefine the relationship between brand and performance.

lists.content:
• Bring performance data, campaign insights, and historical results into the strategic briefing process to ensure creative decisions are grounded in audience behaviour and evidence.

  • Lead performance-focused projects by identifying opportunities in the data, defining strategic direction, and briefing creative teams.

  • Translate campaign concepts into actionable in-market plans across channels, formats, and audience segments.

  • Design creative testing roadmaps and measurement frameworks, including test planning and tracking requirements.

  • Analyse creative performance to understand what is working, what is underperforming, and the reasons behind campaign outcomes.

  • Drive ongoing creative optimisation by scaling successful concepts, improving underperforming assets, and supporting audience progression through the marketing funnel.

  • Turn performance results into clear recommendations on what to scale, stop, or test next.

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, presenting insights, performance results, and recommendations with confidence.

  • Identify opportunities for account growth through continuous optimisation programmes and new performance-focused offerings.

  • Apply an AI-native mindset throughout the strategic process, exploring ways to improve analysis, creative development, and operational workflows.

  • Partner with the product team to develop new performance creative solutions, scalable workflows, and offerings that extend beyond existing tools and capabilities.

  • Share insights and best practices across teams, helping strengthen the connection between creative strategy and performance outcomes.

    • Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in performance or growth strategy within an agency or brand environment, with a strong focus on performance creative.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex performance strategy engagements and influence senior client stakeholders and creative leaders.

  • Proven experience designing and managing creative testing programmes that have delivered measurable performance improvements.

  • Strong analytical capabilities across major advertising platforms, with a working understanding of attribution, measurement, and campaign performance.

  • Full-funnel experience spanning paid social, customer acquisition, and conversion.

  • Ability to identify creative opportunities through data analysis and translate insights into clear, actionable briefs that inspire creative teams.

  • Strong understanding of how brand-building and performance marketing complement one another.

  • Genuine curiosity about emerging technologies, with experience experimenting with or developing new tools, processes, or workflows.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience advising and presenting recommendations directly to senior clients.

  • A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to continuously developing strategic expertise.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote-first work environment: Fully remote company culture, with the flexibility to collaborate across time zones.

  • Global team: Opportunity to work alongside colleagues from more than 60 nationalities and across diverse cultures and disciplines.

  • Meaningful impact: Contribute to work for ambitious global brands and help shape the future of performance creative.

  • High-trust culture: Fast-paced environment built around direct feedback, collaboration, continuous learning, and low-ego teamwork.

  • Career development: Access to mentorship, meaningful responsibility, and opportunities to grow professionally and take on leadership challenges.

  • Opportunity to influence: Join a growing organisation where individual ideas and contributions can shape new services, workflows, and strategic direction.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Self-Serve based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced growth-focused Product Manager to lead and accelerate self-serve acquisition and customer growth across a global developer audience. In this role, you will own the end-to-end customer journey, from first website visit and product discovery to activation, paid conversion, and account expansion. You will shape the product roadmap for the website and application experience, using customer insights, data, and experimentation to improve every stage of the funnel. Working closely with engineering, design, marketing, and revenue teams, you will turn developer interest into lasting product adoption and measurable business growth. You will also explore emerging AI and developer ecosystems to create new acquisition opportunities and more effective product-led journeys. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the growth of an ambitious technology product in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.

lists.content:
• Own and optimize the complete self-serve funnel, defining, measuring, and improving each stage, including signup, trial, activation, paid conversion, and customer expansion.

  • Act as the product owner for the website and application interface, setting the roadmap, defining priorities, and driving improvements to the overall user experience.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering leads, developers, and designers to deliver product and website enhancements that capture demand and increase funnel performance.

  • Design and run conversion experiments, including A/B tests, while partnering with design and product marketing teams to refine messaging, content, formats, and user journeys.

  • Improve product-led growth journeys originating in developer communities, open-source projects, and emerging AI agent ecosystems.

  • Develop a deep understanding of developer workflows, including documentation, SDKs, code examples, and the initial hands-on product experience, to remove friction and encourage adoption.

  • Build intelligent customer data and segmentation approaches using product usage signals and firmographic information to support personalized onboarding, relevant content, and customer nurturing.

  • Work with Revenue Operations to identify product-qualified leads and determine when sales engagement can help convert or expand customer relationships.

  • Establish a rigorous experimentation culture by developing hypotheses, launching tests, evaluating results, and scaling successful initiatives while discontinuing ineffective approaches.

  • Track and report key growth indicators, including signup-to-activation rates, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue, expansion revenue, funnel velocity, and the quality of leads passed to sales.

  • Align marketing, product, customer success, Revenue Operations, and sales teams around shared acquisition and growth objectives.

    • Requirements:

  • 5–8+ years of experience in growth, growth product management, lifecycle marketing, or funnel optimization roles.

  • Proven success driving customer acquisition and managing growth funnels within B2B SaaS, developer-focused businesses, or companies with self-serve and product-led growth (PLG) models.

  • Strong understanding of how developers discover, evaluate, adopt, and use technical products, with experience marketing or building solutions for technical audiences.

  • Previous experience with developer tools, APIs, data products, or other technical platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn websites into effective demand-generation and conversion channels, with direct ownership of conversion performance rather than traffic alone.

  • Track record of improving customer activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion revenue, and customer retention while reducing churn.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven approach, including defining metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting users, and combining product usage signals with targeted messaging and sales engagement.

  • Experience as a Product Owner or Growth Product Manager, working closely with engineering and design teams to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver improvements iteratively.

  • Practical experience using AI coding tools to prototype ideas, build mockups, and create working demos independently.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to align product, marketing, customer success, Revenue Operations, and sales teams around shared goals.

  • Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and how they are changing developer workflows, product discovery, and buying behavior.

  • Production coding experience or contributions to open-source projects are considered an advantage.

  • Familiarity with experimentation platforms, product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4, as well as marketing automation and CRM systems, is a plus.

  • Experience developing product-qualified lead (PQL) strategies or platform-to-enterprise upgrade journeys is desirable.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working environment, with the freedom and flexibility to work from wherever you are most productive.

  • Opportunity to join a self-motivated, progressive, and multicultural international team.

  • Meaningful ownership of self-serve growth strategy and the opportunity to influence product direction and customer experience.

  • The chance to contribute to the expansion of an innovative web data platform serving developers, data teams, and AI builders.

  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies, open-source tools, and emerging AI-driven ecosystems.

  • Opportunities to attend industry conferences and connect with colleagues from around the world.

  • Direct impact on measurable business outcomes, including customer acquisition, conversion, revenue growth, and expansion.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to strengthen the quality and reliability of mobile application releases across iOS and Android platforms. In this hands-on role, you will take ownership of manual regression testing, exploratory testing, bug identification, and release validation. You will collaborate closely with developers, QA specialists, and release managers to ensure smooth, predictable release cycles. Your work will directly contribute to improving product stability, user experience, and overall software quality. This is an execution-focused opportunity for someone who enjoys investigating complex issues, anticipating potential risks, and maintaining high testing standards. You will join a globally distributed engineering environment that values proactive communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

lists.content:
• Execute comprehensive manual regression test cycles on iOS and Android release candidates across a range of supported devices and operating systems.
  • Identify, document, and report bugs with clear reproduction steps, environment details, relevant logs, and severity assessments.
  • Conduct exploratory testing on new features and user journeys to uncover edge cases and potential issues not detected by automated testing.
  • Triage incoming bugs from internal testing, production incidents, and user feedback channels, prioritizing issues according to their impact and severity.
  • Collaborate with developers and release managers throughout release candidate cycles to verify fixes, resolve blockers, and support release decisions.
  • Create, maintain, and expand manual testing documentation, including test cases, checklists, and regression matrices within test management platforms.
  • Perform release-day validation, including smoke testing on production builds and post-release monitoring to ensure product stability.
  • Contribute to improving QA processes, testing consistency, and communication across distributed teams.

    • Requirements:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on manual QA experience testing mobile applications on both iOS and Android.
  • Strong attention to detail, proactivity, and a genuine commitment to delivering high-quality products.
  • Proven experience writing structured and actionable bug reports, including reproduction rates, device and OS information, logs, and severity classifications.
  • Experience managing or supporting complete regression testing cycles within scheduled release environments.
  • Strong exploratory testing capabilities, including session-based, risk-prioritized, and well-documented testing approaches.
  • Familiarity with test management and bug-tracking tools such as TestRail, Xray, Zephyr, Jira, Shortcut, or Notion.
  • Experience conducting real-device testing through BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent written English and asynchronous communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across international time zones.
  • Availability to overlap with Central European Time (CET) business hours for at least four hours per day.
  • Eligibility to work in the country of residence.
  • Nice to have: Experience with automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, WebdriverIO, or Appium.
  • Nice to have: Basic proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, or Go.
  • Nice to have: Previous experience testing cryptocurrency wallets, DeFi platforms, fintech applications, or products handling sensitive financial and user data.
  • Nice to have: Exposure to containerized or cloud-based testing infrastructure and browser extension testing across Chrome, Firefox, or Brave.
  • Nice to have: Familiarity with log and network inspection tools such as Charles Proxy, Xcode Instruments, and Android Studio Logcat.
  • Nice to have: Understanding of release management workflows and release candidate gating processes.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Fully remote working environment with flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals from diverse international backgrounds.
  • Excellent learning, professional development, and career growth opportunities.
  • Exposure to fast-paced, challenging, and innovative projects within the blockchain and Web3 ecosystem.
  • Opportunity to contribute to products shaping the future of decentralized finance and digital asset management.
  • International and collaborative working environment with a relatively flat organizational structure.
  • Flexibility to work remotely from an eligible country, with the ability to collaborate across global teams.

This is an opportunity for an experienced recruitment professional to take ownership of full-cycle talent acquisition across Latin America and the United States. Reporting directly to the Chief Strategy Officer, you will partner with business leaders and hiring managers to attract high-performing talent across business, finance, sales, and manufacturing functions. You will shape sourcing strategies, build proactive talent pipelines, and manage recruitment processes from initial outreach through offer negotiation, including cross-border hiring. The role combines strategic stakeholder partnership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. You will also help strengthen employer branding, improve recruitment operations, and leverage AI-powered tools to make hiring more effective. This is a remote, temporary contract opportunity for approximately six months, with potential extension based on business needs, requiring availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

lists.content:
• Develop and execute effective sourcing and recruitment strategies to attract high-performing candidates across business, finance, sales, and manufacturing functions in Latin America and the United States.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand workforce needs, define role requirements, establish candidate profiles, and create clear, compelling job descriptions.

  • Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, social media, professional networks, and employee referrals, using a variety of channels to reach qualified talent.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both immediate vacancies and anticipated future hiring needs across LATAM and the U.S.

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from initial candidate outreach and resume screening to interviews, selection, offer negotiation, and hiring coordination, including cross-border offers.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Video Producer & Program Lead based in Brazil .

We are seeking an experienced video production professional to build and lead a scalable video program that strengthens brand storytelling and communicates complex ideas across audiences, channels, and regions. This role combines strategic program leadership with hands-on creative production, overseeing the full video lifecycle from intake and prioritization through production, distribution, localization, and performance measurement. You will establish efficient workflows, manage a diverse production portfolio, and collaborate with creative, brand, marketing, regional, and external partners. You will also explore and implement approved AI-assisted tools to improve production efficiency while maintaining high standards for quality, privacy, accessibility, and brand consistency. This is an opportunity to shape a growing video operation and deliver impactful content in a collaborative, globally distributed environment.

lists.content:
• Video Program Development & Operational Leadership

  • Build and activate a repeatable video operating model that improves production volume, quality, turnaround time, stakeholder experience, and alignment with business priorities.

  • Establish a centralized video request process with clear intake requirements, creative briefs, prioritization criteria, production tiers, approval gates, service expectations, and a Monday.com production queue.

  • Lead intake discussions to clarify objectives, target audiences, use cases, distribution channels, timelines, production approaches, reuse opportunities, decision-makers, and success metrics.

  • Manage the video portfolio from initial brief through final distribution, defining ownership, milestones, review deadlines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and next steps.

  • Translate business objectives into creative briefs, storytelling approaches, production plans, resource recommendations, budgets, schedules, and measurable outcomes.

  • Video Production & Creative Execution

  • Personally produce, film, edit, and deliver selected projects while maintaining professional standards for storytelling, pacing, visual quality, sound, accessibility, and technical specifications.

  • Coordinate larger or specialized productions with internal creative teams, freelancers, and external agencies.

  • Manage production scope, schedules, reviews, budgets, handoffs, and quality expectations across projects.

  • Develop reusable video assets in multiple formats, including short-form, vertical, social, advertising, captioned, translated, dubbed, and channel-specific versions.

  • Scale video content across regions through consistent localization and adaptation workflows that preserve the global brand narrative while addressing regional audience and channel requirements.

  • AI-Assisted Workflows & Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate and operationalize approved AI-assisted tools for ideation, scripting, editing, storyboarding, transcription, captioning, translation, dubbing, versioning, metadata management, and performance analysis.

  • Establish appropriate human-review processes and controls to protect brand standards, accuracy, privacy, rights, accessibility, and content quality.

  • Assess AI workflows based on quality, efficiency, cost, time savings, security, and potential risks.

  • Improve video discoverability, reuse, and channel activation through effective metadata, content organization, and handoff standards.

  • Portfolio Management & Performance Measurement

  • Establish reporting on production volume, turnaround times, capacity, engagement, stakeholder experience, and content reuse.

  • Provide insights into portfolio performance, resource requirements, production capacity, vendor management, and investment priorities.

  • Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to refine workflows and support quarterly planning and continuous improvement.

  • Build trusted relationships with Brand Studio, marketing, regional, channel, and external production partners.

    • Requirements:

  • Typically 8 or more years of experience producing and editing marketing, brand, product, customer, corporate, or integrated video content, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Demonstrated experience building or operationalizing a creative production program, workflow, portfolio, or operating model.

  • Strong hands-on proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro and working knowledge of After Effects, Audition, or comparable production tools.

  • Practical experience with video capture, lighting, audio recording, post-production, accessibility standards, file management, and channel-specific delivery specifications.

  • Proven ability to translate business objectives into creative briefs, audience-appropriate stories, production plans, distribution strategies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Experience managing complex creative projects, including prioritization, schedules, capacity planning, scope, budgets, approvals, vendors, dependencies, and risk mitigation.

  • Experience producing reusable and localized content across multiple formats, languages, regions, and distribution channels.

  • Practical knowledge of AI-assisted video and content workflows, including the ability to evaluate quality, rights, privacy, security, costs, efficiency gains, and human-review requirements.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate across creative, marketing, regional, and business teams in a distributed environment.

  • Excellent English communication skills and fluency in Portuguese are required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Film, Video Production, Communications, Marketing, Media, Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

    • Key Success Milestones:

  • First 90 Days: Become familiar with the organization's culture and production environment, build relationships with key stakeholders and mentors, map existing systems and workflows, and establish short- and long-term goals.

  • Within Six Months: Manage a visible and prioritized video portfolio; implement and test intake, prioritization, approval, handoff, and reporting workflows; produce or edit selected projects; develop reusable templates and localization practices; launch initial performance reporting; and pilot approved AI-assisted workflows with documented review controls.

  • Within One Year: Establish a sustainable video program operating model, demonstrate measurable improvements in production output, turnaround, reuse, stakeholder experience, and predictability, and scale localization and validated AI-assisted workflows. Provide portfolio and resource insights for planning while improving video discoverability and distribution standards.

    • Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health coverage.

  • Generous paid time off (PTO).

  • Flexible work options, including remote work from Brazil.

  • Learning opportunities, career mobility programs, and leadership workshops.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours annually.

  • Access to global employee resource groups.

  • Collaborative workplace culture focused on inclusion, creativity, and professional respect.

  • Modern office facilities, including EV charging, healthy snacks, and cultural celebrations.

  • Charitable Giving Program with company matching contributions.

  • Transparent compensation practices, with offers based on role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Workday Solutions Architect based in Brazil.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Workday Solutions Architect to lead the optimization and evolution of an existing Workday environment for an international organization. In this role, you will assess enterprise architecture, identify technical gaps, and design scalable solutions that enhance system performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will take a hands-on approach to Workday integrations, troubleshooting, and architectural improvements while ensuring alignment with business objectives. Working closely with international stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams, you will translate complex requirements into effective technology solutions. As a trusted technical advisor, you will recommend best practices, drive continuous improvement, and take ownership of key technical initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a global technology environment while working remotely with teams and clients across North America.

lists.content:
• Assess existing Workday architecture, configurations, and integrations to identify technical gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Design and implement scalable architectural solutions that optimize Workday performance, reliability, maintainability, and overall system efficiency.
  • Develop, troubleshoot, maintain, and enhance integrations between Workday and third-party enterprise applications.
  • Work extensively with Workday integration technologies, including Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Core Connectors, and Workday Web Services.
  • Design and manage integrations using SOAP and REST services, APIs, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to understand functional and technical requirements and translate them into effective architectural solutions.
  • Investigate recurring system issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend sustainable improvements to prevent future problems.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on Workday architecture, integration strategies, and implementation best practices.
  • Document architectural decisions, integration designs, technical solutions, and recommendations to ensure clarity and maintainability.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor, communicating complex technical concepts and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of architectural improvement initiatives and drive their implementation in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 6 years of professional experience working with Workday implementations, integrations, or solution architecture.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Workday architecture, configuration, and integration design.
  • Proven experience assessing, troubleshooting, and optimizing existing Workday environments.
  • Practical experience with Workday integration technologies, including Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, and Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Solid understanding of APIs, web services, data transformation, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience designing and implementing integrations between Workday and other enterprise applications.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify complex technical challenges and develop scalable solutions.
  • Excellent consulting, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with international business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and take full ownership of technical projects and architectural improvements.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams in a remote environment.
  • Bilingual or near-native English proficiency, with excellent verbal and written communication skills for regular interaction with international stakeholders.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience integrating Workday with other enterprise platforms, such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, or similar systems.
  • Relevant Workday certifications demonstrating expertise in implementation, integration, or solution architecture.
  • Previous experience in enterprise technology consulting or large-scale system transformation projects.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully Remote Work: 100% remote working arrangement, offering flexibility to work from Brazil.
  • Contract Type: Full-time independent contractor engagement.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary paid in USD, based on experience and qualifications.
  • Hardware Provided: Equipment provided to support your remote working setup.
  • Global Exposure: Opportunity to collaborate with international teams and work with clients across North America.
  • Learning and Development: Training and learning stipends to support continuous professional growth.
  • Paid Time Off: Paid vacation, personal leave, and study days.
  • Autonomy and Flexibility: A work culture that values independence, ownership, purpose, and meaningful professional contributions.
  • Collaborative Environment: Join a global team that prioritizes human connection, collaboration, and professional development.
  • Expected Start Date: Early 2027.
  • Working Hours: To be confirmed.
