This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior/Mid Engineering Manager – Delivery based in Brazil.

In this role, you will lead the successful delivery of complex engineering projects across networking, cybersecurity, and data center automation. You will combine strong technical expertise with strategic project management, taking ownership of customer implementations from initial scoping through deployment and handover. Working closely with international clients and senior stakeholders, you will ensure high-quality delivery while managing budgets, profitability, and business growth opportunities. You will also lead and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams, fostering collaboration, performance, and a positive working culture. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to challenging projects for leading global technology companies. The role is fully remote, with occasional international travel to client locations in Europe and the United States.

lists.content:
• Take end-to-end ownership of customer project delivery, from initial scoping and planning through implementation, rollout, and final handover.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, including senior management, ensuring clear communication, strong relationships, and alignment on project expectations.

  • Participate in technical and architectural discussions, contributing engineering expertise and helping define project strategies, technical solutions, and roadmaps.

  • Manage project financial performance, including budgets, margins, and profitability across both Time and Materials (T&M) and fixed-price engagement models.

  • Identify business growth opportunities within existing client engagements, supporting upselling, cross-selling, and presales activities.

  • Lead and develop engineering teams, ensuring effective collaboration, strong team dynamics, and a positive working environment.

  • Oversee the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance and development discussions, and ongoing professional growth.

  • Manage project risks, client expectations, escalations, and scope negotiations to ensure successful delivery and customer satisfaction.

  • Support the continued growth and development of customer engagements while maintaining high delivery standards and operational efficiency.

  • Travel occasionally to client locations in Europe and the United States, typically a few times per year.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as an Engineering Manager, Technical Delivery Manager, or in a comparable technical leadership position.

  • Proven experience managing customer-facing implementation or integration projects, including deployments at client sites.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience handling escalations, managing client expectations, and negotiating project scope.

  • Solid business acumen, including practical experience managing project budgets, financial margins, profitability, and client account growth.

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams of 10 or more engineers working on complex technical projects.

  • Previous hands-on engineering experience in Software Engineering, Networking, DevOps, or Infrastructure.

  • Strong technical knowledge in at least two of the following areas: Networking, Network Automation, Cybersecurity, Data Center Infrastructure, Public Cloud, or CI/CD.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 level or higher), with the ability to communicate effectively with international clients and teams.

  • Flexibility to collaborate across different time zones, particularly EMEA and United States working hours.

  • Strong leadership, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance technical delivery, business objectives, and team development.

    • Nice to have:

  • Previous experience in Professional Services organizations or specialized technology vendors.

  • Experience supporting presales activities and contributing to technical proposals and business development.

  • Professional certifications such as PMI, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience working with international customers and geographically distributed engineering teams.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote work model, with hybrid or office-based alternatives available.

  • Flexible working hours to support work-life balance and international collaboration.

  • Opportunity to work on challenging engineering projects for leading global technology companies.

  • A leadership position combining technical delivery, customer relationship management, and business responsibilities.

  • Dedicated training budget to support professional development.

  • Access to internal training sessions and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

  • Structured, hands-on onboarding to help you integrate into the team and projects.

  • Opportunities to lead and develop engineering teams while contributing to the growth of international client engagements.

  • Occasional international travel to client locations in Europe and the United States.

We are looking for an experienced serviced accommodation operator to help expand an innovative technology platform transforming the short-term rental industry. In this growth-focused role, you will leverage your existing network of Airbnb hosts, property managers, and holiday rental operators to introduce them to a smarter way of managing their businesses. You will demonstrate how AI-powered automation can simplify daily operations, improve guest experiences, optimize pricing, and increase profitability. Working closely with the expansion team, you will generate leads, organize product demonstrations, support sales conversations, and share valuable industry insights. The position offers significant flexibility, allowing you to work remotely alongside your existing accommodation business.

lists.content:
As a Growth Partner, you will use your industry experience, professional relationships, and understanding of short-term rental operations to introduce accommodation operators to an AI-powered property management solution. You will act as a trusted industry representative, helping potential customers understand the platform's value while providing feedback that contributes to product development and market expansion.

  • Leverage your existing professional network to identify serviced accommodation operators, Airbnb hosts, property managers, and holiday rental businesses that could benefit from operational automation.

  • Identify potential customers who are still relying on outdated property management systems or disconnected tools.

  • Introduce the platform and demonstrate how AI-powered automation can simplify short-term rental operations.

  • Organize product demonstrations and engage prospective customers in meaningful conversations about their operational challenges.

  • Support the sales process by building relationships, communicating product value, and helping convert qualified prospects into customers.

  • Explain how automated AI agents can manage guest communications around the clock, across multiple languages.

  • Demonstrate how integrated tools can streamline pricing, cleaning coordination, maintenance follow-ups, channel management, marketing, and financial reporting.

  • Share practical insights from your own accommodation operations to help prospective customers understand the platform's real-world benefits.

  • Act as the voice of accommodation operators within the business, communicating market needs, customer feedback, and opportunities for product improvement.

  • Collaborate with the expansion team to identify new market opportunities and develop effective customer acquisition strategies.

  • Help scale proven growth initiatives by introducing the solution to additional operators and industry contacts.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an active short-term rental or serviced accommodation operator who understands the realities of managing properties and building relationships within the hospitality industry. You should be commercially minded, confident communicating with other operators, and enthusiastic about technology that improves operational efficiency.

  • Currently operating or managing short-term rental properties, serviced apartments, Airbnb listings, Booking.com properties, or holiday homes.

  • Practical experience with the day-to-day challenges of accommodation management, including guest communications, cleaning coordination, maintenance, pricing, and property operations.

  • Established professional network of accommodation operators, property owners, hosts, or hospitality professionals.

  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish trust and engage potential customers.

  • Interest in technology, AI-powered solutions, and automation within the hospitality and short-term rental industry.

  • Ability to explain complex operational solutions in a clear, accessible, and persuasive way.

  • Commercial awareness and confidence supporting product demonstrations and sales conversations.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, initiative, and motivation to contribute to a growing business.

  • Ability to work independently, manage your own schedule, and balance this opportunity with existing professional activities.

  • Strong communication and networking skills, with a customer-oriented approach.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere.

  • Flexible engagement options, including part-time, full-time, or partnership arrangements.

  • Freedom to organize your work around your existing accommodation operations and professional commitments.

  • Flexible compensation package tailored to the right candidate.

  • Opportunity to join an early-stage growth journey within a rapidly expanding short-term rental technology business.

  • Exposure to innovative AI-powered technology and next-generation property management automation.

  • Opportunity to leverage your existing industry network and turn your operational expertise into a growth opportunity.

  • Direct involvement in shaping a technology platform designed around the real needs of accommodation operators.

  • Collaboration with an ambitious international team working to transform short-term rental management worldwide.

We are seeking an experienced Senior ServiceNow Developer specializing in Service Mapping to support the maintenance, development, and continuous improvement of enterprise service management solutions. In this role, you will take ownership of Service Mapping, Discovery, and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) activities, ensuring reliable service visibility and high-quality infrastructure data. You will leverage your expertise in JavaScript and ServiceNow platform customization to develop efficient solutions and integrations. You will also troubleshoot complex technical issues involving MID Servers and Discovery processes, ensuring platform stability and performance. Working closely with technical and business teams, you will contribute to the implementation of scalable solutions aligned with organizational needs. This is an opportunity to bring your technical expertise to a challenging remote assignment with an initial four-month duration and potential for extension.

lists.content:
• Support the ongoing maintenance, administration, and continuous evolution of the ServiceNow platform.
  • Configure, maintain, and optimize Service Mapping functionalities to ensure accurate representation of business services and their underlying infrastructure.
  • Configure, monitor, and manage Discovery processes, ensuring adequate infrastructure coverage and the accuracy and reliability of collected data.
  • Maintain the integrity, consistency, and quality of Configuration Management Database (CMDB) records.
  • Develop and implement platform customizations using JavaScript, Business Rules, and Client Scripts.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations between ServiceNow and external systems.
  • Investigate and resolve technical issues related to MID Servers, Discovery executions, and Service Mapping processes.
  • Monitor platform performance and identify opportunities to improve service visibility, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists and business stakeholders to understand requirements and implement effective platform solutions.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of existing workflows, configurations, and technical processes.
  • Document platform configurations, custom developments, integrations, troubleshooting procedures, and technical best practices.
  • Ensure that implemented solutions follow platform standards and meet business and operational requirements.

    • Requirements:

  • Proven professional experience developing and maintaining solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Service Mapping, Discovery, and Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
  • Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining Service Mapping functionalities and Discovery processes.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript and experience developing ServiceNow customizations using Business Rules and Client Scripts.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining integrations within the ServiceNow platform.
  • Practical experience troubleshooting MID Servers, Discovery executions, and related infrastructure connectivity issues.

  • Prepare regular reports on route performance, traffic quality, and operational statistics.

  • Use Excel to analyse traffic data, build reports, create pivot tables, and identify performance trends and improvement opportunities.

  • Apply market knowledge and commercial judgment to support supplier negotiations and improve the competitiveness of the SMS offering.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SOC Analyst – Global Security Operations based in India.

The SOC Analyst will play a central role in protecting enterprise systems and strengthening security operations across a globally distributed organization. In this hands-on position, you will lead complex security investigations from initial alert through containment, recovery, and post-incident analysis. You will work across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS environments to identify threats and reduce organizational risk. Partnering with internal security specialists and cross-functional teams, you will improve detection capabilities, threat hunting practices, and incident response processes. The role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical security events while contributing to a collaborative, international security team. This position follows an afternoon shift schedule and may include participation in on-call rotations.

lists.content:
• Lead in-depth investigations of security incidents across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS environments, determining root causes, scope, and potential business impact.

  • Manage incident response activities throughout the full lifecycle, including containment, eradication, recovery, documentation, and post-incident reviews.

  • Handle escalations from the Managed Detection and Response (MDR) partner, validate investigation findings, refine escalation criteria, and ensure agreed service levels are maintained.

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) rules and queries to improve threat visibility and identify emerging attack techniques.

  • Investigate cloud and SaaS security threats across AWS, Azure, GCP, identity providers, and business applications, including suspicious OAuth activity, token misuse, and compromised accounts.

  • Collaborate with senior security analysts and teams across IT, Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) on threat hunting and detection improvements.

  • Contribute to incident response playbooks, security monitoring enhancements, and operational process improvements.

  • Track and report SOC performance metrics and provide security evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and customer security reviews.

  • Support incident response readiness through tabletop exercises, knowledge sharing, and the continuous improvement of security procedures and documentation.

  • Work afternoon shifts as part of a global team and participate in up to two on-call rotations per month when required.

    • Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, or detection engineering role.

  • At least 2 years of experience independently managing security investigations from initial alert through resolution and closure.

  • Proven experience responding to real-world security incidents, including business email compromise, credential or session theft, malware, ransomware, and cloud account compromise.

  • Strong practical experience with SIEM and EDR platforms, including developing, writing, and tuning detection queries and rules.

  • Hands-on experience investigating security threats in at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience investigating identity and Single Sign-On (SSO) environments.

  • Solid understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, incident response methodologies such as NIST SP 800-61, and common attack techniques across endpoint, identity, and cloud environments.

  • Practical host forensics and log analysis skills across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex security events and make informed decisions independently.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to take ownership of security incidents and collaborate effectively within a globally distributed team.

  • Willingness to work afternoon shifts and participate in up to two on-call rotations per month, including occasional support outside standard working hours.

    • Benefits

  • Fully remote work arrangement within India, with the option to work from the Hyderabad office.

  • Equity eligibility for all team members.

  • 21 days of paid annual leave and 10 paid public holidays.

  • Unlimited short-term paid sick leave.

  • Annual leave entitlement increases to 26 days after five years of service.

  • Option to encash unused accrued annual leave upon leaving the organization.

  • Access to a dedicated, on-demand learning platform to support professional development and continuous learning.

  • Comprehensive group health insurance for employees and their families, including dependent parents, at no additional cost.

  • Additional insurance coverage, including parental protection, personal accident insurance, and term life insurance aligned with job level.

  • Access to telehealth services.

  • Work-from-home allowance of up to INR 12,000 per year, paid monthly.

  • Three fully paid volunteering days annually to participate in corporate social responsibility initiatives and support local communities.

  • Crèche benefit for employees visiting the office.
